Kiran Patel: Quick follow-up on the resume-lite idea. Need a small decision set: eviction semantics, tenant quotas, and how billing treats resumed prefixes.

Marie Lopez: Main worry: double-billing and how clients learn resume failed.

Kiran Patel: Proposal: thin resume token (opaque id + checksum). Edge stores tiny checkpoint in ephemeral store keyed by tenant. If checkpoint is evicted, respond with trailer progress=lost and run cold-retry. Billing: checkpoint has billing_checkpoint_ts; only bill suffix after resume confirmed.

Samir Rao: Storage constraints: per-entry footprint must be tiny. Store a runtime cursor + kvcache signature, not full buffers. Eviction policy: LRU per-tenant, TTL 60s. If evicted, return resume hint and proceed with cold replay.

Anya K: Client UX: send trailer proto with progress enum and prefix_tokens integer. Clients that see progress=lost can surface a retry hint. I'll draft proto.

Jim O'Neill: Fairness: shard resume-store by tenant and enforce resume.active_limit. If tenant over limit, return X-RW-Resume-Denied: quota and metric resume.denied.tenant=<id>. Also surface resume.store.utilization per-tenant in console.

Kiran Patel: Retry budget: introduce X-RW-Retry-Budget header; proxies decrement it. When it hits 0, proxies stop hedging. Helps avoid cross-layer explosion.

Samir Rao: Latency tradeoff: synchronous lookup adds tail latency. Option: client opt-in via header; default off. Also support X-RW-Resume-Wait-Ms for how long client will wait for lookup.

Marie Lopez: Finance needs stable checkpoint_id to link billing events. If resume succeeds, settle checkpoint and bill delta; if lost, bill cold path. Need idempotency keys to prevent double-charges.

Kiran Patel: Example request: headers X-RW-Resume-Token: r_83abf, X-RW-Retry-Budget: 2, X-RW-Tenant-ID: tenant-55. Response trailer: x-rw-resume-progress: complete|partial|lost. Tracing: rw.resume.cache_state=hit|miss|evicted.

gateway-bot: Canary plan: feature flag edge.resume_opt_in. Rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 100% tenants. Metrics: resume.success, resume.evicted, resume.denied, resume.lookup_latency_p50/p95, resume.billing.settled.

Jim O'Neill: Ops will add alert when resume.store.utilization{tenant} > 85%. Also add a per-tenant quota bump UX.

Anya K: I'll drop the trailer proto and client guidance in the RFC branch.

Marie Lopez: Finance will review checkpoint settlement flow. Need clear logs linking checkpoint_id -> billing events.

Kiran Patel: Action items: Samir design store API + TTL; Marie draft billing contract; Anya proto + client guide; Jim console metrics & deny path. I'll update RFC with headers and canary steps.

Kiran Patel: Final note: keep resume opt-in by header, default behavior unchanged for RTT-sensitive clients. Thanks. :rocket:
